html-has-lang.rationale: Add lang to the root document template; the brief's catalog.

label.rationale: Link an existing label to its input via for/id when both exist; the rule must decline otherwise.

image-alt.rationale: Only decorative images (role or known pattern) get alt=""; the rule must decline anything that needs real alt text.

button-name.rationale: aria-label from visible text already in the element; the rule must decline icon-only buttons.

link-name.rationale: aria-label from visible text already in the element; the rule must decline icon-only links.

heading-order.rationale: Correct a skipped level only when layout semantics cannot change; the rule must decline otherwise.

region.rationale: Add a landmark role where the structure is unambiguous; the rule must decline otherwise.

landmark-one-main.rationale: Add a main landmark where the structure is unambiguous; the rule must decline otherwise.

color-contrast.rationale: Needs a colour or design decision.

color-contrast-enhanced.rationale: Needs a colour or design decision.

html-lang-valid.rationale: Needs to know the correct language.

valid-lang.rationale: Needs to know the correct language.

aria-allowed-attr.rationale: Needs to know the intended semantics.

aria-required-attr.rationale: Needs to know the intended semantics.

aria-valid-attr-value.rationale: Needs to know the intended semantics.

aria-roles.rationale: Needs to know the intended semantics.

autocomplete-valid.rationale: Needs to know the field purpose.
